observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor grassy lawn with a large castle-like building and trees in the background during daytime
observation.dancers: a group of young dancers including both male and female youths
observation.formation_and_space: groups shifting between lines, scattered formations, and circling patterns on the lawn
observation.posture: upright and erect torso, straight or slightly bent knees, weight distributed dynamically across feet
observation.footwork: quick stepping, heel-toe accents, and springy leg extensions synchronized to the music; exact subtle foot transitions obscured by camera angles
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to sides at shoulder height or curved gracefully with soft wrists; hands open or balled into loose fists; occasional partnering holds
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and largely still with controlled grace, minimal hip isolations
observation.partnering: intermittent partner contact, holding hands in circles and brief individual pairings
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright standing levels with occasional small leaps, spirited turns, and spinning formations
observation.costume_and_props: boys wear grey patterned tunics, dark trousers, boots, and tall dark hats; girls wear long red dresses with gold embroidery, white veils/headscarves, and red caps
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer details and subtle footwork articulation are obscured by distance and frequent camera cuts

signature_moments.what: boys jump lightly in place while extending arms upward and outward with loose fists
girls perform graceful arm extensions while stepping in a line with flowing long dresses
dancers circle around each other with arms extended, skirts flaring dynamically
